snippet.title: Moonfrost – Official Gameplay Trailer  Wishlist on Steam
snippet.description:
Welcome to Moonfrost 🌙

Moonfrost is a cosy farming life sim RPG where magical moments happen.

🌱 Farm and grow your land
🎣 Fish in peaceful waters
🏡 Build and decorate your home
🔧 Restore a broken world

Our team has spent the past few years carefully crafting this world, and it means a lot to finally share this next step of the journey with you.

👉 Wishlist Moonfrost on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2561630/Moonfrost/ 

Join our community:   discord.gg/9C5h3URd2y

Follow development and stay tuned for more updates as we continue building the world of Moonfrost.
